answer: Payment for graded work sits in escrow until the audit closes, and a failed audit slashes the escrow instead of returning it. A quorum only counts when its seats span unrelated subnetworks, so five accounts behind one ASN are one voice. A clone farm on a single host therefore posts one bond, wins zero quorums, and watches the glacier of its escrow melt on the first bad audit. The signal to watch is seat diversity per quorum: below three subnetworks, treat the grade as unconfirmed. Each new identity starts as a single vertex with no edges, and edges take real work to earn.
